correctness.rationale: Free C5 orbit cellular model has verified (10,41,36) counts. Exact full signed boundary compositions vanish; a 9-edge tree reduces the one-skeleton to 32 circles. The packaged verifier reconstructs all 31 legitimate one-occurrence generator/2-cell homotopy eliminations to two degree-five and three empty words on a single remaining generator. First degree-five attachment creates a Moore space, the second is nullhomotopic there, and three other cells are trivially attached, proving the four-sphere wedge. Domain five labels only; finite exhaustive enumeration, not inference to general prime p.

value.rationale: The first prime quotient in a classic non-wedge-of-spheres theorem by Donau is canonical and natural. Determining its full 2-dimensional homotopy type resolves an attaching-map gap left by the fundamental group and homology ranks, with a reproducible structural CW reduction rather than a tiny numeric or arbitrary-slice improvement. The finding supplies a precise model potentially usable in studying cyclic partition-complex equivariance, but no downstream theorem is asserted.
